☼Traditional Vedic Astrology

Horoscope

In Vedic astrology, a birth chart (Janam-Patri) records the positions of celestial bodies at the time and place of birth. A reading can help you explore traditional interpretations of those placements and reflect on questions that matter to you.

Ask about this service

Understand your birth chart

Share your birth date, time and place so the chart can be prepared. The consultation discusses planetary placements, houses and periods as they are understood in Vedic astrology, with attention to your questions and circumstances.

Rune-casting for reflection

Rune symbols can be used as reflective prompts alongside a conversation about your chart. Their interpretations are part of a traditional divination practice, not a guarantee of future events.

A thoughtful consultation

Bring the questions or decisions you would like to discuss. The aim is to offer context and practical reflection; astrology is not a substitute for medical, legal or financial advice.

How to get started

  1. Provide your birth details
  2. Share the questions on your mind
  3. Discuss the reading and possible next steps
